notes.Coverage check: OK when the requirement has a pull request, at least one test case and a passing latest result. The release job must find no GAP rows in scope.
notes.Revision: Blank for the original requirement; r2, r3 for revisions made by a CR (process definition 5.2).

sheets.name: Gate Log
sheets.title: Gate Log (one row per gate per work item)

notes.Reviewer is not operator: NO means the L3 reviewer ran the AI prompt. That violates separation of duties; the gate is invalid.
notes.Evidence complete: Yes only when L1 passed (or N/A), the L2 checklist is complete, the reviewer is independent where AI was used, and a decision is recorded.

sheets.name: AI Usage Log
sheets.title: AI Usage Log (one row per T11 declaration)

notes.Unresolved at gate: Must be 0 when the gate is signed (process definition 9.5).

notes.Executed manually: Cases executed by hand and NOT automated. An automated case is counted only under Automated, so nothing is counted twice.
notes.Formally deferred: Only cases deferred in writing with a reason, owner and target release.

readme: Companion to PD-AISDLC-01, the AI-Augmented SDLC Process Definition. One workbook per product line and release train.
1. Enter data only in white cells. Grey cells and columns marked (auto) are formulas; do not overwrite them.
2. Row 5 on every sheet is an example in grey italics. Overwrite or delete it; it is excluded from the Metrics sheet.
3. Use the drop-down lists for coded columns so the formulas and filters work.
4. Where a nightly job can feed a sheet (RTM from Jira, Git and the test tool), paste or import into the white columns only.
RTM — requirement traceability matrix. Coverage check flags any requirement without a PR, a test case or a passing result.
Gate Log — one row per gate (G0 to G9) per work item. Flags reviewer = AI operator and incomplete evidence.
AI Usage Log — one row per T11 declaration. Flags AI-generated artifacts without a declaration.
Parity — automation parity per release: approved = executed manually + automated + formally deferred.
Waivers — the T15 register with expiry tracking (90-day maximum).
CP Versions — Context Pack versions, the T14 requests they closed and the lead time.
Defect to Gate — which gate missed each defect and the preventive action (from T06).
Metrics — live summary of the Council metrics, calculated from the other sheets.
RTM: Business Analyst (rows) and QA Lead (test columns).  Gate Log and AI Usage Log: gate owners.  Parity: QA Lead.  Waivers, CP Versions, Defect to Gate, Metrics: AI Governance Council.
